title: Observe Java Future results
why: Ignoring a Future suppresses asynchronous failures and discards the handle needed for cancellation or coordination.
suggestion: Retain, return, compose, or explicitly observe the Future so failures and cancellation remain visible.
limitations: Discarded direct CompletableFuture async factories and known executor submit or schedule calls are reported.
Aliases, custom Future-returning methods, annotations, and deliberate fire-and-forget policies are not inferred.
